model: Beat This! final0 (Foscarin et al., ISMIR 2024), checkpoint ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/beat_this-final0.ckpt (state_dict prefix model. stripped)
fp16_recipe: fp16 except the rotary angle subgraph (Range..Cos/Sin) and ReduceL2 (fp32); converter fp16 round-trip casts removed
mel_filterbank_file: mel_fb.f32.bin (513 x 128 float32 row-major, bins x mels; mag @ fb)

spect.desc: log-mel chunk; T = 1500 normally, shorter only when the whole song has < 1488 frames

beat.desc: beat logits per frame (sum head: beat = beat_lin + downbeat_lin)

preprocessing.audio: mix16 (mono 16 kHz float32 = mean of the 44.1 kHz stereo decode, resampled with soxr HQ), then resampled 16000 -> 22050 (soxr HQ in Python; any good resampler in the browser, compare by tolerance)
preprocessing.stft: center=True with REFLECT padding of 512 samples on both sides; frame_i = x_pad[441*i : 441*i + 1024]; periodic Hann w[n] = 0.5 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*n/1024); rfft 1024 -> 513 bins; magnitude (power=1) divided by sqrt(1024) = 32 (torch.stft normalized=True)
preprocessing.n_frames: F = 1 + floor(N22050 / 441) (50 fps; frame i centred at i*0.02 s)
preprocessing.mel: mel[f, m] = sum_k mag[f, k] * fb[k, m], fb = torchaudio melscale_fbanks(n_freqs=513, f_min=30, f_max=11000, n_mels=128, sample_rate=22050, norm=None, mel_scale=slaney): Slaney mel scale (linear below 1000 Hz, 200/3 Hz per mel; log above, logstep = ln(6.4)/27), 130 mel points between mel(30) and mel(11000), triangular filters with peak 1.0 (NO area normalisation), evaluated at FFT bin frequencies k*22050/1024
preprocessing.chunking: beat_this split_predict_aggregate: starts = arange(-6, F-6, 1488); if F > 1488 the last start := F - 1494; chunk = spect[max(start,0) : min(start+1500, F)] zero-padded with max(0, -start) frames on the left and max(0, min(6, start+1500-F)) on the right (the only chunks shorter than 1500 frames: F < 1494... in practice every chunk is 1500 frames when F >= 1494); run the model per chunk

postprocessing.aggregate: drop 6 border frames from each chunk output; write into (F,) buffers initialised to -1000 at [start+6, start+1494); earlier chunks win on overlap (process chunks in reverse order and overwrite)
postprocessing.peaks: for beat and downbeat logits x separately: p is a peak iff x[p] == max(x[p-3..p+3]) (out-of-range treated as -1000) and x[p] > 0 (prob > 0.5)
postprocessing.dedup: deduplicate_peaks(width=1): consecutive peak indices with gaps <= 1 form a group replaced by the mean of its indices (can be a half-integer); times = index / 50
postprocessing.downbeats: each downbeat time is replaced by the nearest beat time (argmin |beat - d|, first on ties); then np.unique (sorted, duplicates removed); if there are no beats downbeats are kept as they are
postprocessing.stored: beats and downbeats rounded to 4 decimals; tempo_bpm = 60 / median(diff(beats)) (null if < 3 beats); song.py uses the DBN-free minimal postprocessor (dbn=False)

wasm_note: fp32: dynamic int8 tested and rejected (accuracy below the fp16 graph)
